requirements.requirement: 记忆模块：私有偏好与终态情节、检索和证据链接
requirements.evidence: memory.py; hub; UI five scoped episodes

requirements.requirement: 经验模块：候选、隔离评测、明确发布、撤回及评测查看

工作流每个节点由真实 Agent 任务承载
requirements.evidence: two main flow runs and live-proposal run with frozen Agent profiles and verified Runtime tasks

requirements.requirement: 工作流创建、节点编辑、依赖、版本、运行、授权、取消、恢复、归档
requirements.evidence: workflows.py; HTTP and invariant tests; UI conversation adoption/start/grant/restart

requirements.requirement: 通过 Agent 对话创建工作流并继续编辑历史对话
requirements.evidence: workflow_chat.py; closed Schema; live Codex conversation chat-d99f25df6e8945f5; UI saved proposal

requirements.requirement: 运行时权限、独立验收、幂等及失败恢复保留
requirements.evidence: 163 tests; 44 P0 cases; restart same child and one draft; upstream invalidation reconciles in-flight effects

requirements.requirement: 工作空间和主体隔离、旧任务兼容
requirements.evidence: HTTP scope/privacy tests; 28 original snapshot hashes unchanged

requirements.requirement: 可运行命令、文档、真实模型证据与界面验证
